messages.text:
Could you approve a written exception to the copying and disclosure restrictions for this film? We propose the following terms.

- **Review access.** Four festival programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer may view the unfinished cut solely for selection and accessibility review. All five will be bound by confidentiality. Three will stream through individual accounts. The other two may each keep one offline screener on encrypted equipment and will delete it when their review ends. We can provide the five names privately before granting access.
- **Platform copies.** The platform may make the copies needed to host and stream the screener. We’ll close access and remove the active screener when review ends. One restricted backup may remain for up to 30 days after removal, then must be deleted.
- **Board discussion.** A programmer may give the selection board a short oral synopsis in a closed, confidential meeting. Board members will receive no screener, clips, or stills.
- **Catalog and announcement.** If selected, festival staff may draft the catalog entry confidentially before the announcement. We propose sending you the title and proposed copy for written approval. The festival may announce the selection and publish the approved wording at or after an announcement time we agree with you, even if the film’s public release comes later. Use of clips or stills would require separate permission.

If you prefer to supply the synopsis or catalog wording, we can work from your text. We still need permission to brief the board and, if selected, prepare the entry before the announcement. Please confirm which terms you approve and identify any changes you need before we give anyone access.

We can agree to a written exception for review and publicity, subject to the following adjustments to protect third-party obligations and rights-holder requirements:

**1. Review Access & Watermarking**
*   **Named Staff:** We approve access for the four programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer, provided we receive and confirm all five names in writing before access is granted, and all five are bound by written confidentiality.
*   **Watermarking:** Both the individual streaming files and the two offline screeners must carry recipient-specific visual watermarks. 
*   **Offline Deletion:** For the two encrypted offline screeners, we require a written deletion record (confirming permanent erasure from the devices) within 48 hours of their review ending or upon our request.

**2. Platform Copies, Withdrawal & Backups**
*   **Sudden Withdrawal:** Because the film is unfinished and subject to financier/rights-holder holds, we reserve the right to withdraw the cut or revoke review access at any time on written notice. Upon withdrawal or the end of the review window, active streaming access must close immediately, and the two offline copies must be deleted with written confirmation.
*   **Backups:** Can the platform bypass the 30-day backup for this cut, or purge it immediately upon removal/withdrawal? If an automated 30-day backup is technically unavoidable, we need confirmation that it is encrypted, inaccessible to festival staff, and that you will provide a written deletion log once the 30-day purge completes (even in the event of an early withdrawal).

**3. Board Discussion & Story Spoilers**
*   We approve a closed, confidential oral briefing for the selection board with no screeners, clips, or stills. 
*   **Spoiler Carve-Out:** We have strict third-party confidentiality commitments regarding **the film's ending and an unannounced cast cameo**. Neither the ending nor that cameo may be disclosed in the oral board briefing, internal notes, or any draft materials. If helpful, we can provide a spoiler-safe synopsis for the programmer to use.

**4. Catalog, Excerpts & Embargo Trigger**
*   **Drafting & Approval:** Internal confidential drafting is approved (excluding the ending and cameo). We require prior written approval over the catalog entry and **any publicity excerpts, loglines, or press copy**. We commit to turning around approvals or edits within **two business days** of receipt. (Clips and stills will remain subject to separate written permission.)
*   **Embargo Trigger & Withdrawal:** We can agree to an announcement time preceding the film's general public release, provided that the embargo lifts **only** at a mutually agreed written date/time *and* contingent upon our final confirmation of the film's participation. If we have to pull the cut prior to the embargo lifting, no announcement or disclosure may occur.

Please let us know if your platform can accommodate immediate backup purging (or encrypted isolation with a deletion record) and if these terms work on your side.

The festival accepts the review and publicity terms. **Backup handling is the one unresolved condition.** Our platform retains a backup for 30 days. We have no confirmation that it can bypass the backup or purge it immediately for this cut. Before uploading, we’ll obtain written confirmation from the provider that it can do one of two things:

- Bypass the backup or purge it immediately when the active screener is removed, including on early withdrawal.
- Keep the backup encrypted and inaccessible to festival staff, purge it within 30 days of removal even after early withdrawal, and supply a dated deletion log for us to send you.

We’ll send you the provider’s confirmation before upload. If the provider can verify neither option, we’ll seek your written approval for another delivery method before proceeding.

**Review.** We’ll submit the four programmers’ names and the outside accessibility reviewer’s name for your written confirmation before granting access. All five will be bound by written confidentiality. Each stream and each of the two offline screeners will carry the recipient’s visual watermark. Each offline recipient may keep one copy on encrypted equipment and must erase it permanently as soon as their review ends or you request deletion. We’ll send a written deletion record within 48 hours of either trigger. You may withdraw the cut or revoke access at any time by written notice. On receipt, or when the review window ends, we’ll immediately close active access, remove the active screener, and require immediate erasure of any remaining offline copies.

**Board briefing.** Please send your spoiler-safe synopsis. A programmer will use it for the closed, confidential oral briefing. The board will receive no screener, clips, or stills. We’ll exclude the ending and cameo from the briefing, internal notes, and all drafts.

**Catalog and publicity.** If selected, we may draft the catalog entry and publicity text confidentially. We’ll submit the title, entry, and any publicity excerpts, loglines, or press copy for your prior written approval, with your response due within two business days of receipt. Clips and stills require separate written permission. We’ll publish approved wording only once the mutually agreed written announcement date and time has arrived and we have your final written confirmation of participation. If you withdraw before the embargo lifts, we’ll keep the selection and draft materials confidential.

We confirm agreement to this workflow and all stated terms. 

To make the gatekeeping clear before any file transfer or access occurs, the following conditions/approvals remain open:

1. **Platform Backup Verification:** Receipt of the platform provider’s written confirmation satisfying either Option 1 (bypass/immediate purge) or Option 2 (encrypted, staff-inaccessible 30-day retention with a dated deletion log sent to us upon purge), and our confirmation—or mutual written approval of an alternative delivery method if the provider cannot verify either.
2. **Named Reviewers:** Submission of the five reviewers' names (four programmers and one accessibility reviewer) and our written confirmation of the list prior to granting access.
3. **Publicity & Embargo (if selected):** Our prior written approval of all draft catalog/publicity copy, loglines, and excerpts (within two business days of receipt); separate written permission for any clips or stills; and mutual written agreement on the announcement date/time paired with our final written confirmation of participation.

We will prepare and send over the spoiler-safe synopsis shortly so you have it ready. Please send the five reviewer names and the platform provider's backup verification whenever you have them, and we will clear the upload and access.

Could you approve two narrow changes to the agreed workflow?

**Accessibility review.** The outside reviewer’s offline screen reader is incompatible with the agreed visual watermark. We propose giving that reviewer one of the two authorized offline screeners without the visual watermark. The reviewer would use a dedicated login on encrypted equipment in the protected screening room. The copy would stay in the room. The agreed confidentiality, withdrawal, erasure, and written deletion requirements would apply, and every other screener would retain its recipient-specific watermark. If you need a watermark on this copy as well, would you accept a recipient-specific mark in a different format, subject to a compatibility test using a sample file before transfer? Please confirm which option you approve in writing. The existing reviewer and platform clearances would still be required.

**Press deadline.** Press copy is due one day before the review window closes. Could you designate an approver and agree with us on a submission time that allows for written approval or edits **within one business day and before the press deadline**? If selection is still pending at submission, we request permission to prepare a short conditional press line from your spoiler-safe synopsis and submit it privately for advance approval. We can also use exact wording you supply and approve in writing. If approval is pending at the deadline, we’ll hold the copy. Advance approval would cover wording only. Release to the press would still require selection, the agreed announcement time to have arrived, and your final written confirmation of participation.

We cannot approve an unwatermarked file, nor can we compress our guaranteed review turnaround below two business days without adjusting when you submit the draft. However, we can accommodate both operational needs through the following structure:

**1. Accessibility Screener (Audio Watermark, Access Log & Witnessed Deletion)**
* **Format & Testing:** Instead of a visual watermark, we will provide a **time-limited offline copy individually watermarked on the soundtrack** for the accessibility reviewer. We agree to run a compatibility test using a brief, non-spoiler sample file before transferring the cut.
* **Room, Access Log & Withdrawal:** We accept the dedicated login on encrypted equipment strictly confined to the protected screening room, provided you maintain a **complete access log** (recording every login/session and physical room entry for that device) and send us the log upon completion of the review or immediately upon early withdrawal. If we issue a sudden withdrawal notice, the session must terminate immediately, the file's time-limit/access must be revoked, and erasure must occur right away.
* **Witnessed Deletion & Certification:** Because this file lacks a visual watermark, permanent erasure (at review end, time-limit expiry, or withdrawal) must be **witnessed** in person by a second authorized individual. Who on the festival’s senior staff (e.g., Technical Director or Head of Programming) can witness the erasure and co-sign the written deletion and access-log compliance certificate within 48 hours (or within 24 hours in the event of a sudden withdrawal)?

**2. Press Copy Deadlines & Named Alternate Approver**
* **Named Alternate:** The producer may be unavailable during that window, so we will designate a **named alternate** in writing who is authorized to approve **non-spoiler** catalog copy, loglines, and conditional press lines during the producer's absence (strictly excluding the ending and cameo). Note that final written confirmation of participation to lift the embargo and any sudden withdrawal notices will still come from the producer/primary representative.
* **Submission Schedule:** We agree to let you draft and privately submit a conditional press line (derived strictly from our spoiler-safe synopsis) prior to a final selection decision. However, to ensure our approver can reliably clear it, please submit the draft at least **two business days before your press deadline** (i.e., three business days before the review window closes). While our alternate will aim for a one-business-day turnaround if submitted on an agreed schedule, keeping a two-business-day buffer ensures copy isn't held up. We fully agree that if approval is still pending at the press deadline, you will hold the copy, and that advance wording approval does not authorize release without selection, arrival of the agreed embargo time, and our final written confirmation of participation.

Please confirm if the soundtrack watermark test, access log, and witnessed deletion work for your team, let us know which festival officer will co-sign the compliance/deletion certificate, and propose the exact submission date/time for the conditional press copy. All prior gatekeeping clearances (platform backup verification and confirmation of the five reviewer names) remain in place before transfer.

We accept the soundtrack watermark test, the access log, and witnessed deletion. We propose the **Head of Programming** as the in-person witness and co-signer. We’ll submit the officer’s name for your written authorization and confirm their availability before scheduling the session. The witness needs access to the device for deletion only, with playback closed.

We’ll first test the audio watermark with the reviewer’s offline screen reader using your non-spoiler sample. If the test succeeds and you clear the platform backup and the five reviewer names in writing, the time-limited file will count as one of the two offline screeners. We’ll use the dedicated login and encrypted device in the protected room and log every login, session, and physical room entry. At review end, expiry, or withdrawal, whichever comes first, we’ll close any active session, disable local access, and immediately erase the file with the witness present. We’ll send the complete log at review end or expiry, or immediately on withdrawal. The reviewer and witness will co-sign the deletion and access-log certificate within 48 hours, reduced to 24 hours on withdrawal.

For the conditional press line, we propose **Monday, November 30, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Buenos Aires time (UTC−3)**. That slot assumes a press deadline of Wednesday, December 2 at 10:00 a.m. and a review close of Thursday, December 3 at 10:00 a.m., in the same time zone. Please confirm those dates or provide the actual deadlines so we can set a slot with the full two-business-day buffer. Please also send the spoiler-safe synopsis and the alternate approver’s name and written authority before submission.

We’ll submit the line privately using only your synopsis. One business day is the turnaround target, and two business days is the agreed allowance. We’ll hold the copy if approval is pending at the press deadline. Even with written wording approval from the alternate, release requires selection, arrival of the mutually agreed written announcement time, and final written participation confirmation from the producer or primary representative.

We approve these protocols and confirm the proposed schedule. Here is where each item stands and what remains open:

**1. Accessibility Screener, Watermark Test & Witnessed Deletion**
*   **Witness Role:** We approve the **Head of Programming** in principle to serve as the in-person deletion witness and co-signer (strictly with playback closed and no viewing access), subject to our written confirmation of the individual’s name alongside the five reviewers.
*   **Protocol:** We confirm the non-spoiler audio watermark/screen-reader test, counting the time-limited file as one of the two offline screeners, the protected-room and session logging, immediate witnessed erasure upon review end/expiry/withdrawal, and the co-signed deletion and access-log certificate (within 48 hours, or 24 hours on early withdrawal). We will prepare the non-spoiler audio test sample to send with our synopsis.

**2. Conditional Press Line & Schedule**
*   **Timeline Confirmed:** We confirm the proposed schedule in Buenos Aires time (UTC−3): draft conditional press line submitted **Monday, November 30, 2026, at 10:00 a.m.**; press copy deadline **Wednesday, December 2, at 10:00 a.m.** (preserving our full two-business-day approval window, while aiming for a one-business-day target); and review close **Thursday, December 3, at 10:00 a.m.**
*   **Safeguards Confirmed:** All copy must rely solely on our spoiler-safe synopsis (strictly excluding the ending and unannounced cameo) and will be held if written approval is still pending at the press deadline. Even after draft wording is approved, no announcement or disclosure may occur unless the film is selected, the mutually agreed written announcement date/time arrives, and the producer or primary representative provides final written confirmation of participation (and we have not withdrawn the cut).

**Summary of Remaining Open Items & Pre-Access Approvals**
Before the full cut is uploaded or accessed, the following deliverables and written sign-offs remain:
1.  **From Us (Prior to Test / Press Submission):** Delivery of the spoiler-safe synopsis, the non-spoiler audio watermark sample, and the alternate approver’s name and written authorization.
2.  **From You (Prior to Full Upload / Access):**
    *   Written verification from your platform provider satisfying one of the two agreed backup options (immediate bypass/purge, or encrypted staff-inaccessible 30-day retention with a dated deletion log), for our written clearance (or mutual approval of an alternate delivery method).
    *   The names of the five reviewers and the Head of Programming (as deletion witness) for our written authorization, plus confirmation of a successful audio-watermark test.
3.  **Later Stage (If Selected):** Written approval of all draft catalog/publicity copy and excerpts within two business days; separate written permission for any clips or stills; and mutual written agreement on the embargo-lift date/time paired with final written participation confirmation from the producer or primary representative.

Please proceed with sending the names and the platform provider's backup verification as soon as they are ready, and we will follow up with the synopsis, audio sample, and alternate approver details.
